verdict.rationale: Wave's own pages list onboarding and migration from other accounting software such as FreshBooks, apparently as a Wave Advisors/onboarding service, so a first-party migration path exists. Nothing documents how historical books are brought over or whether transaction-level detail is kept. The payroll-migration claim covers a different system type and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented import of historical ledgers or transactions, assurance that transaction detail is preserved, supported source systems beyond the FreshBooks example, a self-serve import tool versus an advisor-only service, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
